newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish insurer PZU SA pays PLN 5 mln flood damages.
newsitem.headline: Polish insurer PZU SA pays PLN 5 mln flood damages.

text.p: Polish state-owned insurer PZU SA paid out by July 22 five million zlotys in flood damages, after heavy floods inundated southern and western Poland, it said in a statement.

The statement said PZU payments included 425,258 zlotys in damages from obligatory farm building insurance, 95,093 zlotys in optional farming insurance, 1,110,342 zlotys in flat insurance, 255,948 zlotys optional building insurance, 485,135 zlotys for firms and 2,644,009 zlotys optional car insurance.
Earlier the company said it had at its disposal financial resources amounting to 350 million zlotys, which might be used at any time for payments caused by flood damage.
